tasks.short: Divide the work with the assistant, show and instruct on site, watch and correct, sign off practice tasks and report progress.

steps.what: Mechanic divides the day's jobs with the assistant
Mechanic shows and instructs assistants on site
Mechanic watches the assistant's work and corrects it
Mechanic signs off practice tasks: in the assistant's paper training booklet today, on the phone from the task list after the change
Mechanic tells the service manager how the assistant is progressing

tasks.design: The assistant's practice tasks sit as a list in the {LMS}, and the mechanic signs one off on the phone at the job instead of finding the booklet and writing the task out; the judgement and any optional photo stay. Dividing work, instructing, correcting and talking to the manager stay in person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sign-offs went into a paper booklet that was often left in the van.
tasks.enabler_now: Training records on a phone are standard in learning systems.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching is done by showing; a sign-off says little about real skill.
tasks.human_edge: Letting an assistant try and fail safely, then showing the better way.

reach.learn: Whether phone sign-offs keep portfolios complete.

evidence.claim: Learning systems record workplace sign-offs of practice tasks on a phone.
Records about an employee's progress are personnel data; using them to observe performance needs works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from dividing the work to reporting progress; formal exams are outside.
Input contract: practice task list set by the training coordinator; fallback is the paper booklet.
Sign-offs are used for training, not to rate the assistant.
Instruction and supervision keep their full time. s4 keeps 80 because only finding the booklet and writing out the task goes; judging the work and any optional photo stay.
unknowns: Whether the assistant is an apprentice with a training plan.
research_questions: Do assistants finish training sooner with a visible task list?

incremental.description: No ongoing upkeep: learning the sign-off screen is a one-off.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the training coordinator keeps the paper booklet for most tasks, so little changes (0.5); high: all practice tasks on the list (2.0).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The HVAC mechanic keeps teaching on the job; only the paper booklet goes.
skills_to_grow: Giving useful feedback when signing off
role.ambitious_version: A mechanic whose assistants learn fast and whose sign-offs are always up to date.

job.title: Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers
